description: Shared Renovate config for udondan repositories

packageRules.description: Keep Cargo.toml in sync with Cargo.lock.
ESLint plugins and configs have peer dependencies on eslint, typescript-eslint and prettier. Updated separately, npm fails with ERESOLVE.
rubocop extensions depend on the rubocop version.
First-party actions keep their version tags. Third-party actions are pinned to a commit SHA.
The reusable workflow of boarding-gate is used by its major tag, so every release reaches all repos without update PRs. It runs the action of its own commit.
Own packages, actions and images are updated right away, without waiting for the minimum release age.
Own packages without the udondan name, such as unscoped npm packages, matched by their source repository.
Runtime dependencies of an npm package use the build type. release-please only releases for build(deps), chore(deps) stays out of the changelog. Only the root package.json ships.
Runtime dependencies of a Python package use the build type, see above.
Runtime dependencies of a Rust crate use the build type, see above.
Dependencies of a Swift package use the build type, see above. Package.swift has no dev dependencies.
Dependencies of a Go module use the build type, see above. Indirect dependencies and tools stay chore.
Actions used by a published action use the build type, see above. Actions in .github are CI and stay chore.
